summary.whatChanges: In the Vitest UI test explorer summary, the SKIP counter now always shows a real number instead of "--", and pass/fail/skip totals are computed from the actual matched tests rather than being suppressed when a pass/fail filter is active.
behaviorChanges: Explorer summary SKIP badge shows an actual count at all times, not '--' unless 'Only Tests' mode is on.
Skipped and todo tests are now tallied into the summary's skipped total instead of being ignored.
Failed counts are no longer forced to 0 while the pass-only filter is active (and vice versa); e.g. a failing file matched via a passing child now reports fail=1.
Summary numbers no longer change based on which status filters are toggled.
risks: Counts shown may no longer align with the filtered list of visible items, since totals now include states excluded by the active status filter.
The 'Only Tests' filter flag is now unused for the SKIP display, so skipped totals at file level and test level may be conflated.
